description: Functional specification: extend Channels IncomingNormalization/Incoming with a shared sanitized-media path, using optional native channel classification callbacks in WhatsApp and Telegram integrations. Validate provider, room, top-level kind, sender and author consistency before producing facts. Only use sanitized path for empty raw and nonempty media; retain raw validations and Discord independent evidence policy. Pure local-only boundary normalization, no new Action; reuse existing source_scope and MessageTimestamp helpers. Tests before implementation: new focused generic normalization test module, real WhatsApp adapter media sealing and Telegram normalized fixtures; property-test inconsistent room/sender/kind/provider rejection. Branches: valid room/direct, invalid evidence, unsupported callback/provider, nonempty contradictory raw. External mocks only at WhatsApp media transport. Document public callback and service contract. Existing test behavior unchanged. See epic comment for generic requirement.

comments.text: Implemented optional conversation_type/1 integration callback plus shared sanitized-media consistency validation. WhatsApp and Telegram opt in through native classifiers; existing raw validation remains authoritative. New regression failed before implementation; 2 properties and 12 normalization tests now pass. mix q passes after correcting alias ordering. No existing test assertions changed.

title: [zaq-scg] Normalize sanitized media through a shared adapter contract
